'''Hartke''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] he was posted at the [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]] in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]].<ref name="Blockade Runner" />
